facts: Published file corrections are supported within 30 days; exceptional later changes can involve support.
A DOI alone is not a cryptographic byte identity.
Versions have separate records, files and persistent identifiers.

scope: Documentation-only observations from the separately frozen one-query/two-page menu. Web-service raw response hashes, timings and peak memory were not retained; no invented measurements. Not a reconstruction of the prior rejected ETag.
